title: J'zargo's Experiment
description: J'zargo asks the player to test his experimental Flame Cloak scrolls on undead creatures. The scrolls prove dangerously explosive, harming allies as well as enemies. After reporting results, J'zargo becomes available as a follower.

base_facts: J'zargo is a Khajiit student at the College of Winterhold.
J'zargo is ambitious and believes himself to be very skilled in magic.
J'zargo has been developing new Destruction spells.

BEAT_ACCEPT_EXPERIMENT: J'zargo has given the player ten Flame Cloak scrolls to test on the undead.
BEAT_UNDEAD_KILLED: The player has killed undead with J'zargo's Flame Cloak scrolls.
The scrolls cause a massive explosion that harms the wielder and nearby allies.
BEAT_REPORT_COMPLETE: J'zargo's experiment had an unfortunate side effect, but he is grateful for the help.
J'zargo is now available as a follower.
BEAT_QUEST_FAILED: J'zargo no longer wants the player's help after they exhausted all ten scrolls without killing enough undead.
The quest has failed; J'zargo does not become available as a follower through this experiment.
All ten Flame Cloak scrolls were used up without achieving the three required undead kills.
There is no way to obtain more copies of J'zargo's scrolls to retry the experiment.

beats.comment: Player agrees to help J'zargo test his Flame Cloak scrolls on undead.
Player has killed three undead with the scrolls and should report back.
Player reports the scroll results to J'zargo and the quest finishes.
Player ran out of scrolls without killing enough undead; quest fails.
